mapper.select: WITH TEMP_YIELD AS ( SELECT PROD_ID, (case UNIT_VALUE_TOTAL when NULL then 1 else UNIT_VALUE_TOTAL end) UNIT_VALUE_TOTAL FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY YIELD.PROD_ID ORDER BY YIELD.CHANGE_DATE DESC) RN, YIELD.PROD_ID, YIELD.UNIT_VALUE_TOTAL FROM CHB_PRD_PERIODYIELD YIELD ) WHERE RN = 1 ) /*非零售、对公、同业非保本理财*/ SELECT PROPERTYCODE AS vcode, IFNULL(BALANCE, 0) AS value FROM CHB_MONTH_REPORT_DETAIL DETAIL WHERE DETAIL.REPORTUUID = (SELECT REPORTUUID FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY T.TERMID ORDER BY T.UPDATE_TIME DESC) RN, T.REPORTUUID, T.TERMID FROM CHB_MONTH_REPORT T ) WHERE RN = 1 AND TERMID = #{termId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) /*零售非保本理财*/ UNION ALL SELECT 'amt51A' AS vcode, IFNULL(SUM(AMT51A.ENDAMTSUM_OTH), 0) AS value FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT POSUUID, ENDAMTSUM_OTH FROM CHB_MONTH_PRD_POSITION WHERE DATE_FORMAT(ENDDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{dateend, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PROFIT_TYPE='03' AND ENDAMTSUM_OTH IS NOT NULL AND (SALE_TARGET LIKE '%01%' OR SALE_TARGET LIKE '%03%' OR SALE_TARGET LIKE '%05%') )AMT51A /*对公非保本理财*/ UNION ALL SELECT 'amt52A' AS vcode, IFNULL(SUM(AMT52A.ENDAMTSUM_OTH), 0) AS value FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT POSUUID, ENDAMTSUM_OTH FROM CHB_MONTH_PRD_POSITION WHERE DATE_FORMAT(ENDDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{dateend, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PROFIT_TYPE='03' AND ENDAMTSUM_OTH IS NOT NULL AND (SALE_TARGET LIKE '%02%') AND (SALE_TARGET NOT LIKE '%01%' OR SALE_TARGET NOT LIKE '%03%' OR SALE_TARGET NOT LIKE '%05%') )AMT52A /*同业非保本理财*/ UNION ALL SELECT 'amt53A' AS vcode, IFNULL(SUM(AMT53A.ENDAMTSUM_OTH), 0) AS value FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT POSUUID, ENDAMTSUM_OTH FROM CHB_MONTH_PRD_POSITION WHERE DATE_FORMAT(ENDDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{dateend, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PROFIT_TYPE='03' AND ENDAMTSUM_OTH IS NOT NULL AND SALE_TARGET = '04' )AMT53A

SELECT CASE /*次日*/ WHEN TEMP_INFO.EDAYS = 1 THEN 'A' /*2日-7日*/ WHEN TEMP_INFO.EDAYS BETWEEN 2 AND 7 THEN 'B' /*7日-30日*/ WHEN TEMP_INFO.EDAYS BETWEEN 8 AND 30 THEN 'C' /*31日-90日*/ WHEN TEMP_INFO.EDAYS BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 'D' /*91日-1年*/ WHEN TEMP_INFO.EDAYS BETWEEN 91 AND 365 THEN 'E' /*1年-5年*/ WHEN TEMP_INFO.EDAYS BETWEEN 366 AND 1825 THEN 'F' /*5年-10年*/ WHEN TEMP_INFO.EDAYS BETWEEN 1826 AND 3650 THEN 'G' /*10年以上*/ WHEN TEMP_INFO.EDAYS > 3650 THEN 'H' /*逾期限*/ WHEN TEMP_INFO.EDAYS <= 0 THEN 'I' /*未定期限*/ ELSE 'J' END AS eDays, POSITION.ENDAMTSUM_OTH AS prinamt, TEMP_INFO.PROD_ID AS attributeId, TEMP_INFO.OPERATION_TYPE AS attributeType FROM ( SELECT (case T.OPEN_DAYS when NULL then 1 else T.OPEN_DAYS end) EDAYS, B.FINPROD_MARKET_ID PROD_ID, B.OPERATION_TYPE FROM FIN_OPEN_RULE T LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO A ON T.CASH_ID = A.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID WHERE A.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C01' AND T.OPEN_TYPE IN ('01', '03') AND B.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL AND B.OPERATION_TYPE = '02' UNION ALL SELECT A.MDATE - #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} EDAYS, A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID PROD_ID, A.OPERATION_TYPE FROM FIN_PRODUCT A WHERE A.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL AND A.OPERATION_TYPE = '01' ) TEMP_INFO LEFT JOIN CHB_MONTH_PRD_POSITION POSITION ON TEMP_INFO.PROD_ID = POSITION.PRODID WHERE POSITION.ENDDATE = #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND POSITION.ENDAMTSUM_OTH IS NOT NULL
